meta.name: install
meta.description: Scaffold a booping project under ~/Claude/{project}/ and attach it to the current repo. Use when onboarding a new repo or formalizing an existing one.

copy.tagline: 为新项目搭建booping脚手架并关联仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地快速创建booping项目并关联Git仓库
copy.tagline_en: Scaffold a booping project and attach it to the current repo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a booping project and link it to a Git repo

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在 ~/Claude/ 下创建一个以项目名命名的文件夹，并将当前仓库与该文件夹关联，用于管理项目。
howto.when: 当你需要为新仓库或现有仓库建立项目结构时，可以要求 Claude 执行安装。

say.text: 帮我为当前仓库安装项目结构，项目名叫 my-app。
为新仓库 my-app 初始化项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates a folder named after the project under ~/Claude/ and attaches the current repository to it for project management.
howto.when_en: When you need to scaffold a project structure for a new or existing repository, you can ask Claude to run the install.

say_en.text: Install the project structure for the current repo with project name my-app.
say_en.note: Claude will create ~/Claude/my-app/ and attach the current repo.

say_en.text: Initialize a project for the new repo my-app.
say_en.note: Claude will run the install process.
